collection.description: The collection (an index on Pinecone, a class on Weaviate). vector_list_collections lists them.

namespace.description: Pinecone: the namespace (empty: the default one). Weaviate: the tenant of a multi-tenant collection. Milvus: the partition. Not used by Qdrant and Chroma.

records.description: The records to write; a record with an existing id replaces it. A person approves the exact records.

id.description: A record id: text, or an integer where the store's ids are integers (Qdrant, Milvus with Int64 keys).

vector.description: The record's vector, or its named vectors as {"name": [...]} (Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus). Leave out on Pinecone indexes with integrated embedding: they embed the document.

metadata.description: The record's fields (payload, properties, scalar fields).

document.description: Chroma: the record's document. Pinecone with integrated embedding: the text it embeds.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
